title: Restore draft workspace to snapshot Version 66 (no redeploy)

requirements.text: Restore/reset the current draft development workspace to exactly match snapshot Version 66, discarding any draft-only changes introduced after Version 66, and do so without triggering any new build or live deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace contents match Version 66 snapshot (no later-version code changes remain).
No new build artifacts or deployments are triggered as part of the restore operation.
No additional credits are consumed for performing the restore operation.

requirements.text: After the workspace restore completes, verify the restored workspace against the existing “Version 66 Reset Verification” checklist in frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md and report pass/fail for each checklist section.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft build label checks for Version 66 are validated per the checklist.
Basic app stability checks (no build/runtime errors) are validated per the checklist.
Core Version 66 functionality checks are validated per the checklist.
Confirmation is provided that no features from later drafts (e.g., Versions 77–80) are present, per the checklist.

constraints: Do not trigger a new build or deployment while restoring the workspace to Version 66.
Do not modify application code as a substitute for restoring the workspace snapshot.
User-facing text in any status/confirmation output must be in English.
nonGoals: Implementing new features or UI changes unrelated to restoring the workspace state.
